checks: LPSN evidence binds the specific validly published 1992 homotypic synonym, not the invalid 1953 entry or a heterotypic relation.
The author-institution title, DOI and abstract must all bind the explicit synonym; unrelated mentions are insufficient.
Other-name matches require independent nomenclature evidence; duplicate, inactive and ambiguous taxon identities fail closed.
The exact unranked Salmonella name remains unranked and is not replaced by its species ancestor.
The earlier formal new-combination review is reused with its PDF, receipt and rendered-page pins; no new full-text review is claimed.
New protein queries bind the resolved name context, exact source gene token, metadata field scope and complete native response.
Protein candidates retain native review status and independent taxonomy; reference identity does not assign an allele, tested organism or genome.
The HTTP 302 source remains a no-redirect hold, with no retry, alternate route, full-text review or permanent-unavailability inference.
Request attempts, canaries, receipts, bodies and error sets reject unaccounted artifacts.
The CLI supports nested output parents and refuses to overwrite a differing saved audit; offline replay denies network and file writes.
residual_risks: The Tapesia primary nomenclature source was not retrieved, and unsupported spellings and non-individual source labels remain unresolved.
Metadata-only exact gene searches do not establish resistant alleles, strain identity, source genome identity or genotype-phenotype joins.
The Pseudocercospora name crosswalk uses the title and abstract rather than full-text experimental or phylogenetic review.
All four new protein references are unreviewed UniProt entries and have no overlap with the terms' own definition citations.
The 103-term reference count covers the frozen 178-term cohort only; the full corpus investigation remains open.

access.discovery_search_note: One web discovery search was mistakenly restricted to indexed PubMed results. No NCBI page was opened or NCBI endpoint requested, and those results are not evidence in this audit.

full_authoritative_qc.limitation: RDKit is absent in the existing Intel macOS environment. No full authoritative QC or biological-curation verification is claimed.
